I’m Dan the Dog Man — a combat veteran and professional dog trainer with a background in canine psychology and animal behavior. Based on experience, not just theory. On this channel, I break down real-world dog training, focusing on behavior, obedience, and the root causes behind aggression, reactivity, and lack of control.

I don’t just teach commands — I teach structure, communication, and how to build a clear relationship between dog and owner. You’ll see real training sessions, behavior modification, and step-by-step breakdowns in challenging situations like vet visits, leash reactivity, and high-drive dogs.

My approach is built on trust, respect, and clarity — creating calm, reliable dogs through consistent, real-world training. If you’re looking for dog training tips, behavior correction, and real case studies, this channel is for you. 

Subscribe for real, lasting results.
